thread:
ashley_ml: Quick sync — triage for the three intake models: nightshade-7b, iris-1.2B, vellum-13B. Need final owners, licensing clearance, and perf profiles before catalog launch.

jorge_curator: I can own nightshade and vellum manifest + evals. Who picks up iris?

priya_product: I was assigned iris initially but I flagged the license as murky. @maria_legal can confirm.

maria_legal: Confirmed — iris-1.2B metadata says CC-BY-NC-4.0. That blocks hosted API and dedicated shared tiers. Customer-facing private only unless licensor permits commercial use. :lock:

ashley_ml: Ok — mark iris as PRIVATE_ONLY for now in the manifest. We'll keep it in catalog but hide hosted endpoints. @jorge_curator can you add a note in the model doc?

jorge_curator: Yep, will add "visibility": "private-only" and a short license summary.

kevin_infra: Quick infra note: nightshade perf runs show a 95th latency bump around 1024-seq due to KV cache pressure. Small patch to batching kernel helped in staging but need perf profile update. Log snippet: `95th=312ms @ seq=1024, baseline 220ms`

ashley_ml: Thanks Kevin. @jorge_curator can you capture a perf profile for nightshade with the regen set (short/med/long) we use in catalog? We need the sequence distribution so runtime picks the right kernel.

jorge_curator: On it. I have a quick harness but need permission to spin dedicated canary GPUs for 2 hours.

priya_product: Proposed canary: us-west1 dedicated, 50rps, 2h window, traffic routing -> staging->canary->fallback. Any objections?

kevin_infra: ACK, infra capacity looks available. For nightshade 50rps should be fine, vellum might need more memory — we should pin quantization profile before canary.

ashley_ml: Vellum note noted. @jorge_curator which quantization do you want to test?

jorge_curator: Start with q4f32 (default) and one run with q2_k for cost estimate.

maria_legal: Also to reiterate: iris must not be part of any hosted canary. Keep iris in private-only pool.

ashley_ml: Understood. I'll update the intake ticket (INTAKE-3129) to reflect owners and constraints.

priya_product: Can someone post the exact deploy command for the canary so I can add to the product playbook?

ashley_ml: Sure — paste below.

ashley_ml: ```
# canary start (example)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/canaries \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"nightshade-7b","pool":"dedicated-us-west1","rps":50,"duration":"2h","rollout":"staging->canary"}'
```

deploy-bot: Canary created: ID canary-20240222-009, status=PENDING :rocket:

kevin_infra: I'll watch metrics. If 95th > 400ms for two consecutive 5-min windows we auto-abort and fallback to smaller model variant.

priya_product: Timeline for catalog launch gating: we want model docs, license notes, perf profile, and canary pass by EOD Friday. Is that realistic?

jorge_curator: Nightshade & vellum: yes if canary runs tonight. Iris: blocked on license exception or move to private-only listing.

maria_legal: We can try to request licensor permission, but don't count on fast turnaround. Recommend private-only flag as default.

ashley_ml: Action items: Jorge (add license note + perf profiles for nightshade and vellum), Kevin (monitor canary + auto-abort), Priya (update product playbook with deploy command), Maria (send license request for iris). I'll update INTAKE-3129 and flag release runbook.

priya_product: Thanks all — ping me in thread when canary status changes. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary canary-20240222-009 status=RUNNING (started 1708765455)

ashley_ml: Great — I'll check back after 30m and post a short summary.

kevin_infra: Early signal: nightshade p50=86ms p95=298ms, memory stable. Will post full metrics at +30m.

jorge_curator: Added license + visibility note for iris to the manifest. Marked ellipses for owner review.

maria_legal: Sent license request email to maintainer (cc: priya_product). Subject: "Commercial usage clarification for iris-1.2B". I'll update here when I hear back.

ashley_ml: Perfect — thanks team.

(End)
